## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Aug 16, 2026 - Nov 15, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _wacosveryown_, Nov 15, 2026, 1/5: "I attempted to email their customer support with zero luck. I am now giving a one star review, so hopefully the issue will finally be resolved since I can’t seem to get in touch with anyone at customer support on the matter. this app is unusable on the iPhone dual every time you log a meal the app just deletes everything you log a couple seconds later."
            2. _cartercoltrane_, Nov 14, 2026, 1/5: "I’ve used it for years and it’s always been buggy. But it’s my system of record for my food data so what you gonna do. Bugs these days: - randomly drops weights I’ve added - can’t add a picture for a weight already logged - ads that are supposed to be stuck to bottom of screen float in the middle, preventing clicks - random issues syncing with apple health—foods will not show up in apple health calories or macros. Doesn’t happen all the time. Necessitating deleting and re-adding the food. - no cardio activity for 11min/mile jogging?? There’s one for 10min, 11.5min… why not just add one for 11min??"
            3. _Marjoleinloes_, Sep 20, 2026, 1/5: "This used to be my most used app, I switched from paid to free several times. The last update however made this app completely unusable. Hopefully it changes back very soon, otherwise I have to find a new app that works. Sorry, but never had an update on any app which really made an app grom great to terrible. Who decided on this???"
